decisions.reason: As a newly launched product in the firm's core construction-machinery space with continued dedicated market presentation and no clear sign of performance below aspiration, management would likely keep it while allowing more time for market acceptance.

This articulated construction dumper appears close to the firm's established capabilities, so under bounded rationality and with no observed failure signal yet, the firm would likely retain it rather than reallocate resources immediately.

The underground mine rescue vehicle is a much narrower and more uncertain niche, which raises the risk of falling short of aspiration levels, but a mature German machinery firm would still likely keep it one more year while assessing whether the market develops.

The compact telescopic loader fits a familiar equipment segment and, absent evidence of serious underperformance, organisational slack and the short time since launch make continued support more likely than withdrawal.
